Configure Pre-Inference PII Detection and Redaction Rules

Source: R/pii.R
pii_config.Rd

Builds a validated PII detection configuration controlling which built-in entity classes are active, plus lab-supplied custom regex patterns, custom literal dictionaries (e.g., local clinic names, participant lists), and allowlisted terms that must not be flagged.

Usage

pii_config(
  entities = pii_default_entities(),
  custom_patterns = NULL,
  custom_dictionary = NULL,
  allowlist = NULL,
  detect_unlabeled_names = TRUE,
  case_sensitive_dictionary = FALSE
)

Arguments

entities

Character vector of built-in entity types to detect. See pii_default_entities().

custom_patterns

Optional named character vector of PCRE regular expressions, where names specify the entity type label (e.g., c(study_code = "STUDY-[0-9]{5}")).

custom_dictionary

Optional named list of character vectors containing literal sensitive terms grouped by entity type (e.g., list(clinic_name = c("Hartford General"), person_name = c("Maya Lin"))).

allowlist

Optional character vector of literal terms or phrases that must never be flagged as PII (case-insensitive exact match).

detect_unlabeled_names

Logical scalar; if TRUE (default), enables capitalization-based detection of multi-word person names (filtered against common clinical/academic stopwords) in addition to titled (Dr. ...) and role-labeled (Patient: ...) names.

case_sensitive_dictionary

Logical scalar; whether custom_dictionary matching is case-sensitive. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_pii_config" with canonical config_digest.

Examples

cfg <- pii_config(
  custom_patterns = c(study_id = "UCONN-[0-9]{4}"),
  custom_dictionary = list(clinic = c("Valley Behavioral Clinic")),
  allowlist = c("Beck Depression Inventory")
)
print(cfg)
#> <airgap_pii_config>
#>   Entities:          email, ssn, street_address, zip_code, mrn_id, ip_address, phone, date, age_over_89, person_name
#>   Custom patterns:   1
#>   Dictionary terms:  1
#>   Allowlist terms:   1
#>   Unlabeled names:   TRUE
#>   Config digest:     sha256:5fa4db5bb1149bc7d2bef719b8af8912e5175edab8d36c9cc3a8d7a3a58389c8
